text:
sophia: Noticing a batch of underpayments to Azure marketplace partners in April payouts. Can someone look at entitlement mapping for reserved SKUs?
dan: Which partners affected?
sophia: Initial scan shows 5 partners, biggest is CloudBridge (~$4.5k short). The marketplace feed shows usage attributed to 'azure-private-reserved' but our partner mapping expects 'azure-reserved'.
kevin: That smells like a normalize-key bug in the marketplace ingestion. We added a new namespace 'azure-private' last month for private offers. Did the mapping table get updated?
aris: I got a ticket from Partners: they received invoice but partner statement shows fewer partner_rev lines. Ticket ref: PART-1219.
finance-bot: Automated alert: marketplace-ingest-v3 reported 7 warnings: sku_key mismatch on 2026-04-30. See /alerts/ingest/2026-04-30/sku-mismatch.log
dan: Can you paste one of the feed rows showing mismatch?
sophia: Pasting minimal CSV row we pulled from marketplacefeed.csv:```
subscription_id,sku,period,allocated_units,unit_price,amount,partner_share
SUB-4401,azure-private-reserved-8cpu,2026-04,10,500,5000,0
```
sophia: Note partner_share 0 because mapping failed, partner_id blank in the ingest.
kevin: That's consistent. The new sku prefix isn't in sku_to_partner table. On deploy the migration added prefix but the downstream cache in billing-service didn't refresh.
aris: How far back? April only or earlier?
sophia: v3 ingest started 2026-03-22. I see sporadic missing mappings from 2026-03-25 onwards.
dan: Impact estimate?
sophia: Quick calc: 5 partners, total partner_share gap = ~$12,400 for March+April. CloudBridge is $4.5k, AquaChannel $3.1k, others smaller.
kevin: I can patch the sku mapping table and trigger a cache flush. Will open PR for mapping additions and an infra job to warm billing-service caches.
kevin: PR: https://git.redwood.internal/p/marketplace-ingest/pull/512 - adds azure-private prefix mappings and cache invalidation hook.
dan: For payouts already run, we need retro adjustments. Sophia / Finance, can we recompute affected payout ranges?
sophia: Yes please. Finance: mark these partners for manual tweak. I've created a spreadsheet with rows flagged: /internal/finance/adj/marketplace-mapping-2026-04.csv
finance-bot: Recompute job requested: marketplace-recompute-2026-03-04 (job id b4c9). Pending approval for compute window.
aris: I'll coordinate with Partners to notify them. Draft note: "We discovered an ingestion mapping gap causing partner revenue omission for reserved Azure SKUs. We're issuing top-ups for March-April and will include statements."
kevin: After mapping fix I can replay ingestion to regenerate partner_share fields. We should avoid double-crediting by marking processed run ids.
dan: Who approves the top-ups? Policy says adjustments <$25k can be approved by Head of Finance. Sophia, please route the CSV to Emma for sign-off.
sophia: Sending to Emma now.
finance-bot: Approval received: adjustment-batch-2312467950 approved by emma.
kevin: Ingestion replay started. Logs: /logs/ingest-replay/b4c9.
aris: Partners asked for timelines. I told them 3 business days to see credits. Is that still accurate?
sophia: Yes, pending replay success and payout scheduler run.
d an: Small nit: we need a regression test for sku prefix normalization in ingest unit tests. Kevin please add.
kevin: Will add test case and include mapping table validation in CI.
finance-bot: Replay completed: 5 partner rows updated. Adjustment CSV updated: /internal/finance/adj/marketplace-mapping-2026-04.csv (now includes partner_revenue values).
sophia: Re-run payout scheduler queued for next cycle. Finance will inject top-ups as one-off credits.
aris: Draft partner comms reviewed and sent to Partners for final sign-off.
dan: Postmortem items: 1) Add mapping health dashboard 2) Cache invalidation on mapping migrations 3) Clear owner for mapping table changes. I'll create FIN ticket.
kevin: PR merged. Added tests + cache flush job.
finance-bot: Adjustment batch processed: payout-topup-2312468125 completed. Partners will see credits next payout.
sophia: Thanks all. Closing on our side once FIN ticket created.
aris: Creating FIN-5130 and linking PR + logs.
sophia: Great work team, smooth handling :thumbsup:
